newsitem.title: UK: Hanson optimistic, sees U.S. expansion.
newsitem.headline: Hanson optimistic, sees U.S. expansion.

text.p: Hanson Plc, the rump building materials group left over from the recent conglomerate demerger, said on Thursday it saw most of its expansion opportunities of the next 12 months coming out of U.S. markets, which are expected to remain buoyant.

Turning to ongoing talks on the sale of Hanson's U.S. hydraulic equipment division Grove Worldwide, deputy chairman and chairman designate Christopher Collins said the company was in talks with a number of parties but that nothing was imminent.
Collins said the group remained optimistic for the second half of the year despite a flattening out of growth in some British divisions.
Andrew Dougal, chief executive, told a news conference "I am very optimistic indeed for the outlook of our operating divisions."
Dougal said the slowdown in some British divisions in the first half had been due to poor weather in June and the quiet holiday period.
